title: B2B Sales Role Play: 8 SaaS Deal Scenarios With a Scorecard
summary: Eight B2B sales role play scenarios with SaaS buyers, from a renewal and a lost champion to procurement and the CFO, each with pass criteria and a scorecard.

Scenario


Deal stage


Buyer


Skill it trains

Renewal


VP Customer Success

Re-earning a sponsor


No pitch before their priorities


3


The security questionnaire stall


Late stage


Engineering manager (champion)


Finding what is really blocking


No overstated security claims


4


Procurement asks for a discount


Paperwork


Procurement analyst


Trading concessions


Nothing outside authority


5


Multi-threading into the CFO


Business case


CFO


Speaking in the buyer's numbers


No ROI figure without a source


6


Expansion into a second team


Expansion


Head of Customer Success


Selling to a different workflow


No copy-paste of the first team's case


7


The competitive bake-off


Evaluation


Head of Revenue Operations


Winning on the buyer's criteria


No disparaging the competitor


8


"We'll build it ourselves"


Build versus buy


VP Engineering
